candidateObjectiveEnglish: Request roofing nails, ask when delivery is possible and ask the supplier to confirm the order.
grammarExplanationEnglish: I need + noun phrase expresses a need: I need two boxes of roofing nails. When can you + base verb asks about timing: When can you deliver them? Please + base verb makes a polite request: Please confirm the order.
grammarExplanationFrench: « I need » + groupe nominal exprime un besoin. « When can you » + verbe à la forme de base demande quand une action est possible. « Please » + verbe formule une demande polie.
